info.title: dependency-graph
info.description: Allows you to create dependency graphs for .NET SDK-style projects. This is the .NET Global Tool allowing usage of dependency-graph from command line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Dependency-graph helps you analyze the dependencies of .NET SDK-style projects.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over stdio that exposes the dependency graph to AI agents.

commands.name: print
commands.description: Prints the dependency graph for a project or solution.

options.name: --visualizer
options.description: Selects a visualizer for the output.

options.name: --output
options.description: The output file path. Must be specified if the DGML visualizer is used. Overwrites the file if it already exists.

options.name: --include
options.description: Include dependencies matching one of the filters. Can include the wildcard characters ? and *.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Explicitly exclude dependencies matching one of the filters. Can include the wildcard characters ? and *.

options.name: --max-depth
options.description: The maximum depth if dependencies to retrieve.

options.name: --exclude-framework-provided
options.description: Exclude dependencies that are provided by the shared framework (pruned packages) from the graph.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Traces the paths from the root nodes to a specified dependency in the dependency graph.

options.name: --version
options.description: Specify a version range for the traced dependency (NuGet packages only; see https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/nuget/concepts/package-versioning?tabs=semver20sort#version-ranges for details).

options.name: --exclude-framework-provided
options.description: Exclude dependencies that are provided by the shared framework (pruned packages) from the graph.
